# A visible mechanism carries a single item

## Statement
Where the material shows how something works rather than only that it happened,
following one item through the mechanism reads better than comparing several.

## Applies when
feature mechanism_present is yes

## Influences
- S-09 · `E-13.reader_path` — which candidate strategy survives selection.

## Conflicts
K-MAT-10 prefers the comparison wherever the material has comparable items.
Same tier, lower confidence — and its review has not lapsed.

## Source
A fixture record for the knowledge loader: the non-expired record of the same
tier that a demoted one loses to.
